Page.description:
Standard pagination inputs for admin list endpoints. Flatten this into a
per-resource request struct alongside that resource's own filter fields:

```ignore
#[derive(Deserialize, ToSchema)]
pub struct ListThingsRequest {
    #[serde(default)]
    search: Option<String>,
    #[serde(flatten)]
    page: Page,
}
```

Recipient.description:
A recipient is referenced by id or by stable uuid. Callers outside the
odo database (apps that hold only uuids) use the uuid; when both are
given, the id wins.

RecipientActivityPage.description: One page of per-recipient delivery activity.

total.description: Total rows matching the filter, ignoring limit/offset.

RecipientActivityRow.description: One recipient's deliveries in a window.

Sort.description:
Standard sort inputs for admin list endpoints. Flatten this into a
per-resource request struct alongside `Page`:

```ignore
#[derive(Deserialize, ToSchema)]
pub struct ListThingsRequest {
    #[serde(default)]
    search: Option<String>,
    #[serde(flatten)]
    page: Page,
    #[serde(flatten)]
    sort: Sort,
}
```

`sort_by` is a client-supplied string, so a handler must NEVER map it to a
column directly — resolve it against an explicit allow-list with
[`Sort::resolve`], which falls back to the handler's default for any
unknown or absent key.

sort_by.description: Logical column key to sort by (must be one the handler allow-lists).

oneOf.description: Sort direction; defaults to ascending when a `sort_by` is given.

SortDir.description: Sort direction for a list endpoint.

total.description: Total rows matching the filter, ignoring limit/offset.

body_template_html.description: Empty string clears the HTML variant.
